templates.title: The love theme you carry
templates.question: Which film's love theme lives in you -- and what does it sound like when it becomes yours?
templates.summary: Movies -> chords -> emotions -> notes. Pick a film love theme; hear its catalogued chord movement (never the melody); see which of the 15 letters of love it carries; blend in your own memory; get the notes of your feeling and a new progression written in them, played on a heartbeat.

stages.prompt: Pick a film whose love theme you carry.
stages.why: Film composers lean on a small set of chord movements to say 'love'. We catalogue the movement (chord names, key) with full credit -- facts about the work, the way textbooks do -- and never the melody, lyrics or recording.

visualization.caption: The chord movement, credited. Confidence shown.

a11y.label: Pick a film whose love theme you carry.
a11y.hint: Choose from the list. Arrow keys or type to search, Enter to choose.

stages.prompt: Listen to just the chords. Here is what they carry.
stages.why: Each chord is read three ways: its quality (major brightens, minor aches, maj7 softens, sus leaves a question open), its job in the key (home, lift, pull, ache), and the moves between chords (an arrival, an 'amen', a door that opens somewhere unexpected).

visualization.caption: The 15 letters of love, as these chords lean.

a11y.label: Listen to just the chords. Here is what they carry.
a11y.hint: Nothing to choose here; the result is read out when it is ready.

stages.prompt: When you hear it, what comes back to you?
stages.why: A theme means something different to everyone who carries it. Your answer is blended with the chords, two parts chords to one part you.
